title: West Africa country profile evidence register
purpose: Track authoritative country-level agricultural survey sources before any values are admitted into GoOrganicAfrica calculator profiles.
publication_rules: Do not add a country to the active calculator dataset until its required commodity fields have been reviewed and validated.
Do not treat a country survey yield as a selling price or a complete farm budget.
Record commodity, production system, unit, geography, reference year, publication date, source URL, sampling uncertainty and any revision notice for every extracted value.
Use published aggregate tables unless the source explicitly authorizes the intended use of microdata.
Do not invent missing values. Leave unsupported fields for farmer entry or retain the clearly labelled Africa benchmark.
Do not change the calculator formula or the existing ten country profiles as part of this research package.

survey.title: Liberia Annual Agriculture Survey 2024
survey.publisher: Liberia Institute of Statistics and Geo-Information Services (LISGIS), with Ministry of Agriculture
survey.coverage: National and regional estimates; agricultural households

known_revision_notice.description: The official LISGIS erratum for the Liberia Annual Agriculture Survey 2024 corrects wording on page 9 (fertilizer-use and uncertified-seed proportions) and page 16 (characteristics of holdings and land). The erratum does not list Table 10, Table 35 or Table 38 among the corrected sections.

survey.license_and_use: The LISGIS open-data licence page lists the 2024 crop cultivation, crop loss, crop production/yield, inputs, labour and livestock/poultry aggregate datasets as CC BY 4.0. Confirm the licence for each selected table or download before redistribution.
survey.extraction_status: Table 10 and selected labour-cost tables have been transcribed as provisional observations from the published report. The March 10 2026 erratum identifies edits to the Executive Summary and Key Findings, not Tables 10, 35 or 38. However, the LISGIS portal also displays a general August 2026 revision notice with unclear scope. More importantly, the published Table 10 yield column does not reconcile arithmetically with harvested quantity divided by harvested area. Keep all Liberia values on hold pending source-table clarification and confirmation of the August notice scope.

verified seed and planting-material prices
current fertilizer and crop-protection costs
crop-specific low/expected/high yield ranges or a defensible multi-year method
livestock purchase, feed, veterinary, mortality and output-price benchmarks
regional production-cost profiles and farm-system assumptions
confirm crop taxonomy for beans and pepper before mapping to existing commodity profiles
confirm whether the general August 2026 LISGIS revision notice affects LAAS-2024 Tables 10, 35 or 38
obtain LISGIS clarification on the Table 10 yield denominator and reconcile published yields against production and harvested area
table_references: Table 10, planted area, harvested area, harvested quantity and yield, report page 37.
Table 35, other agricultural production costs, average daily payment and duration, report page 72.
Table 38, average daily hired-labour payment by gender and region, report page 77.

provisional_observations_on_hold.caution: The report says only 28.3% of cassava households harvested during the survey period; yield is timing-specific and may understate annual output.
Crop type is reported as beans; do not assume this is cowpea without confirming the species.
Pepper type is not specified as Habanero or another particular variety; planted area has CV 46.44%, so treat the observation as low confidence.
Harvested area and production are flagged with high sampling uncertainty in the report.
Harvested area and production are flagged with high sampling uncertainty in the report.
Production is flagged with high sampling uncertainty in the report.
Planted and harvested area are flagged with high sampling uncertainty in the report.

provisional_labour_costs_on_hold.note: These are reported daily wage observations, not per-hectare labour budgets. Dashes in the source table are withheld values, represented as null. All values remain on hold pending LISGIS erratum reconciliation. Child labour amounts are intentionally not carried into calculator costing assumptions.

observation_caveats: All numeric values transcribed from the published October 2025 report are provisional and on hold pending identification of tables affected by the August 2026 LISGIS correction notice.

The report flags pepper planted area, rubber planted/harvested area, sweet-potato harvested area/production, eggplant harvested area/production and okra production as high-uncertainty indicators (CV > 33% or SE > 17.5%).
Cassava yield is timing-specific: only 28.3% of cassava households reported harvesting during the survey reference period, and the report warns that annual output may be understated.
A single national yield observation is not a low/expected/high calculator range.
Daily labour and other service-payment averages cannot be converted into per-hectare budgets without activity duration, worker counts and farm-system assumptions.

Arithmetic review found that the report's published yield values do not consistently reconcile with harvested quantity divided by harvested area (for example, rice: 201,074 Mt / 139,707 ha = about 1.439 Mt/ha, while the table reports 2.0 Mt/ha). Do not use the published yield column or the recalculated ratio until LISGIS confirms the correct yield denominator and resolves the August 2026 erratum.
The March 10 2026 LISGIS erratum identifies changes to the Executive Summary and Key Findings, not the crop-yield or labour tables transcribed here.

A separate August 2026 portal notice refers to selected corrected tables and indicators but does not identify the affected table numbers in the accessible notice; its relevance to LAAS-2024 remains to be confirmed.

An official corrected-report download is now identified on the LISGIS survey record. Re-extract Table 10 and the cost tables from that corrected report before treating earlier transcriptions as valid.

additional_portal_revision_notice.description: The LISGIS survey portal also displays a general notice that selected previously published survey tables and indicator values were corrected or revised.
additional_portal_revision_notice.verification_required: The accessible notice does not identify the affected report tables. Confirm whether it applies to LAAS-2024 and whether Tables 10, 35 or 38 are affected before promoting observations.

corrected_report_access.note: LISGIS's official survey record explicitly provides a corrected report, the old report and an erratum document. Future extraction must use the corrected report, not the earlier direct PDF URL. The March 10, 2026 erratum text itself specifies changes to pages 9 and 16; the corrected report still needs to be checked for the Table 10 yield denominator.

survey.title: Sierra Leone Annual Agricultural Survey 2024
survey.publisher: Statistics Sierra Leone and Ministry of Agriculture and Food Security, with FAO technical support
survey.coverage: National coverage except Western Urban district
quality_notes: The metadata reports sampling-error estimates for selected indicators.
The public-use dataset version was updated to reflect changes in input-use and input-detail rosters after the post-harvest visit.
The metadata states that a confidentiality declaration/access conditions apply to data files; review these conditions before any microdata use.
survey.extraction_status: Published Table 2.5 extracted into this evidence register as national point observations. These are not low/expected/high calculator ranges and are not yet admitted to calculator country_data.
remaining_gaps: obtain district-level Agrilinks price observations for calculator crops and confirm the date, variety, market and unit conversions
obtain dated supplier quotations for certified seed, fertilizer, agrochemicals and planting materials from NaFRA-listed suppliers
obtain livestock purchase, feed, veterinary, mortality and output-price benchmarks
resolve the 2025 MAFS rice yield denominator discrepancy and reconcile the 2024 household-survey and 2025 crop-cutting methods
derive low/expected/high values only from verified district/ecology distributions or multi-year observations
confirm the chilli pepper variety and broad-bean taxonomy before mapping the 2024 survey crops to existing calculator commodities
survey.table_reference: Table 2.5, planted area, harvested area, production and yield of crops cultivated by agricultural households, report page 24.
observation_caveats: These are national survey point estimates for the 2024 reference year, not low/expected/high production ranges.
The report covers national agricultural households; the country report notes coverage and sampling design details in its methodology and annex.
Do not treat crop production statistics as farm-gate prices or production-cost observations.
Check the report's detailed methodology and any indicator-specific sampling-error notes before using an observation as a forecast input.

additional_surveys.title: 2025 Sierra Leone National Crop Production Survey Report
additional_surveys.publisher: Ministry of Agriculture and Food Security (MAFS), Planning, Evaluation, Monitoring and Statistics Division (PEMSD)
additional_surveys.method: Crop-cutting yield measurements combined with GPS-measured cultivated area; stratified sampling by district and rice ecology. The report describes a 95% confidence level and 5% margin of error for the sampling design.
methodology_notes: Rice uses a district- and ecology-specific sampling frame and a target sample of approximately 6,300 rice-producing households.
Other major crops use the 2023 agricultural household listing frame and district-stratified sampling.
Onion observations were collected through targeted phone surveys of major private producers.
The report covers rice, cassava, maize, cocoa, sweet potato, groundnut and onion.
quality_notes: The national rice yield of 2.37 Mt/ha does not reconcile with 1,441,015 Mt divided by 661,016 ha (approximately 2.18 Mt/ha). Ask MAFS to clarify the yield denominator or corrected area before calculator use.
The report's district-level rice yields range from Moyamba at 1.53 Mt/ha to Kambia at 2.89 Mt/ha; these district observations should not automatically be treated as universal low/high scenarios.
The 2025 crop-cutting survey and 2024 household survey use different measurement methods; do not average their results without methodological reconciliation.
Reported point yields are not complete farm budgets or low/expected/high forecast bands.
additional_surveys.extraction_status: National yield and production figures transcribed from the published report. No values are promoted to calculator data pending source checks and current prices/costs.

market_price_sources.title: Agrilinks Sierra Leone market information platform
market_price_sources.coverage: Regional markets across Sierra Leone; district-level averages
market_price_sources.units: Local market units (bags, cups, pans, ties, etc.) with conversions to price per kilogram or litre
market_price_sources.access: Online platform after registration; USSD access for Orange numbers via *2474#.
market_price_sources.notes: Potential source for district-specific price observations. Obtain current data and confirm the platform's terms, dates, market names, varieties and conversion factors before use.

input_price_sources.title: National Fertilizer and Regulatory Agency (NaFRA) data and agro-dealer directory
input_price_sources.publisher: National Fertilizer and Regulatory Agency, Sierra Leone
input_price_sources.notes: Use to identify suppliers and request dated quotations for fertilizer, seeds and crop protection products. The directory itself does not provide verified current retail prices.

survey.title: USDA Foreign Agricultural Service Production, Supply and Distribution country profile — Guinea
survey.publisher: United States Department of Agriculture, Foreign Agricultural Service
survey.extraction_status: Source identified and current 2025/2026 country-level estimates visible. No numeric observations admitted to calculator data until commodity selector, units, marketing-year definitions and national-statistics cross-check are documented.
quality_notes: USDA FAS is a useful independent cross-check, not Guinea's national statistical authority.
Do not map peanut to the existing beans/cowpea profile.
Do not use a cereal aggregate yield as a rice or maize yield.
Confirm each commodity's selected yield series and unit before extracting values.

price_sources.title: FAO Food Price Monitoring and Analysis Tool
